chunk.title: Service and Returns
chunk.heading: AX-17 standard returns
chunk.text:
## AX-17 standard returns
Standard AX-17 units can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Keep the order number when opening a return request.

chunk.title: Service and Returns
chunk.heading: AX-17 custom unit exception
chunk.text:
## AX-17 custom unit exception
Custom-configured AX-17 units cannot be returned unless faulty. If a custom unit is faulty, contact support to start the service process.

chunk.title: AX-17 User Manual
chunk.heading: AX-17 login errors
chunk.text:
## AX-17 login errors
On the AX-17, ERR-4022 means the account token expired. Sign out and then sign in again to get a fresh token.

chunk.title: AX-17 User Manual
chunk.heading: AX-17 network errors
chunk.text:
## AX-17 network errors
On the AX-17, ERR-4021 means the network cable is disconnected. Reconnect the network cable, wait for the link light, and retry the connection.

chunk.title: AX-17 User Manual
chunk.heading: AX-17 diagnostics
chunk.text:

Use send_logs() to export diagnostic logs. Save the export locally before attaching it to a support ticket.

Hold Power for 5 seconds, then press Recovery. Wait until the status indicator turns blue.

## AX-17 firmware 2.1 recovery
Hold Power for 10 seconds, release it, then press Recovery. Wait until the status indicator flashes before releasing Recovery.

## AX-17 password and reset
Use the account recovery link to reset a forgotten password. A factory reset deletes local settings. It is a separate procedure from password recovery.

## AX-17 network errors
On the AX-17, ERR-4021 means the network cable is disconnected. Reconnect the network cable, wait for the link light, and retry the connection.

## AX-17 custom unit exception
Custom-configured AX-17 units cannot be returned unless faulty. If a custom unit is faulty, contact support to start the service process.

passages.text:
## Support hours
The support team is available Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 local time. Weekend requests are handled on the next business day.

## AX-17 standard returns
Standard AX-17 units can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Keep the order number when opening a return request.

## AX-17 diagnostics
Use send_logs() to export diagnostic logs. Save the export locally before attaching it to a support ticket.

## Shipping label
Support sends a prepaid return label after approving a return. Print the label and remove the original shipping label from the box.

## AX-18 upload
The AX-18 accepts individual uploads up to 40 MB. The limit also applies to attachments in support tickets.
